sections.content: Variables Python mein boxes jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon jaa'oon joon ahin. Har variable ka ek data type hota ahe (jaise number, text, ya boolean). Input/output da matlab ahe program aur user beech communication—user to data lena (input) aur results show karna (output).

sections.label: Example
sections.content:
# Variable declare karna
naam = "Ali"  # String (text)
age = 25      # Integer (number)
height = 5.9  # Float (decimal number)
is_student = True  # Boolean (True/False)

# Input lena
user_name = input("Apna naam likhein: ")
print("Hello, ", user_name)

# Data type check karna
print(type(age))  # Output: <class 'int'>

sections.content: Ek program likhein jo user to 2 numbers input le, unko add karke result print kare.
